# Medina Clean

Medina Clean is a bilingual local cleaning business led by Rosa Medina near Woodstock, GA and ZIP 30188.

Primary services:
- House cleaning
- Apartment cleaning
- Condo cleaning
- Deep cleaning
- Recurring cleaning every 2 or 3 weeks after the first service
- Small business cleaning reviewed case by case
- Post-construction cleanup after onsite review

Service area:
- Main service center: Woodstock, GA 30188
- Nearby Georgia communities reviewed by ZIP and exact address include Marietta, Kennesaw, Acworth, Canton, and Roswell.
- The website uses free ZIP validation within about 20 miles of 30188. Rosa confirms the exact address before accepting a job.

Pricing:
- Rosa gives a free, personalized quote for each home; the final price is confirmed after she reviews the details.
- Options include recurring cleaning (every 2 or 3 weeks), first-time or one-time deep cleaning, optional oven and refrigerator cleaning, small business cleaning, and post-construction cleanup.
- No fixed public rates are advertised; request a free quote for your specific space.

What's included:
- Full room-by-room checklist for the standard clean, detailed/deep clean, and move-in/move-out clean, plus the do/don't list and available add-ons (laundry, dishes, linen changes, interior oven cleaning, interior refrigerator cleaning): https://medinaclean.com/en/whats-included (Spanish: https://medinaclean.com/es/que-incluye)

Customer actions:
- English appointment requests: https://medinaclean.com/en#schedule
- Spanish appointment requests: https://medinaclean.com/es#schedule
- Phone: +1 470-781-4143

AI assistant booking (agent-native / MCP):
- Medina Clean runs a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server so AI assistants can check the service area, give an instant starting estimate, and submit an appointment request to Rosa from inside a chat.
- MCP endpoint: https://medinaclean.com/mcp
- Tools: check_service_area, list_services, get_pricing_rules, get_estimate, request_appointment.
- An assistant can REQUEST an appointment; it never confirms one. Rosa reviews the exact address, timing, and property, then contacts the customer to confirm.

Trust and privacy:
- Appointment requests and pending reviews are private.
- Reviews and review photos are public only after approval and consent.
- Real Medina Clean project videos may be linked from the public gallery.
- Do not claim licenses, insurance, certifications, awards, or years in business unless Rosa provides confirmed proof.
